cards.title: Copy as Plain Text (strip markdown for pasting elsewhere)
cards.description: Research #5 portability/ownership + #6 mobile capture (notes get pasted into email/Slack/Messages). Editor already has Copy as Markdown and Copy as HTML but no plain-text copy that strips the syntax (#, **, ==, [](), - [ ]). Add inklingCopyAsPlainText: alongside the existing copy commands. One menu item, no config.

cards.title: Export as PDF (direct, alongside Export as HTML)
cards.description: Research #5 file ownership/portability: a note you own should be shareable as a durable, universal artifact. Today the only PDF route is Print (Cmd-P) -> Save as PDF, which is undiscoverable. Add a direct Export as PDF... next to the existing Export as HTML..., rendering the same PrintableNoteView to a PDF via NSPrintOperation. No config.

cards.title: Remember scroll/cursor position per note when reopening long notes
cards.description: Research #2: Craft caps notes at 20k chars; a user couldnt paste a 2-hour lecture transcript. Washi handles long notes but every time you switch away and back it jumps to the top, forcing you to re-find your place. Remember the last cursor/scroll position per note (in-memory, keyed by note URL) and restore it on reopen. Invisible robustness for long transcripts, no config, no persisted setting.

cards.title: Relevance-rank search results (title matches first, then body, then image OCR)
cards.description: Research: find it instantly months later is called THE killer feature (u/Fun_Shine8720); 2026 market data names open->write->find-later as the biggest unmet need. SidebarView.filteredNotes and QuickSwitcherView.results do plain substring .contains in modified-date order, so an exact title match can rank below recent notes with an incidental body hit. Add shared NoteStore.search() ranking exact-title > title-prefix > title-contains > body > OCR, recency tiebreak.

cards.title: Materialize not-yet-downloaded iCloud notes on launch
cards.description: Research: sync anxiety / 'new device shows nothing' — Obsidian ⭐1 (Jun 2026) 'Does not load even in new phone', and the note-app research 'sync anxiety and data loss' section. reload() lists only visible .md files with .skipsHiddenFiles, so iCloud placeholder stubs (.<name>.md.icloud, hidden, not yet downloaded) are skipped and the app shows 'No Notes' or a partial list on a fresh device. Call startDownloadingUbiquitousItem for placeholders + not-current .md files, then re-read once they land. Invisible robustness, no config.

cards.title: Surface a 'downloading from iCloud' state in the sync indicator
cards.description: Research priority #3: visible, trustworthy sync. checkSyncStatus() only inspects upload status; a note still downloading reads as empty yet the dot shows SYNCED. Add ubiquitousItemDownloadingStatus awareness so the indicator shows SYNCING while content is still arriving.

cards.title: Duplicate note command
cards.description: Research: templates in Obsidian/Craft require manual markdown/config (XDA '3 reasons I uninstalled Obsidian'). A one-click Duplicate gives poor-man's templates with zero configuration — copy the file, open the copy. No template system, no complexity.

cards.title: Heading outline popover for navigating long notes
cards.description: Research: Craft ⭐1 caps notes at 20k chars; a user couldn't paste a 2-hour lecture transcript. Washi handles long notes but has no way to jump around them except ⌘⇧↑/↓. A lightweight outline popover (list of headings → click to scroll) helps long transcripts without adding a persistent panel.

cards.title: Show a clear placeholder for broken/missing image references
cards.description: Research: file ownership / portability. When an attachment file is missing (moved, not yet synced), the inline image renders as nothing. Show a labelled placeholder so the user knows a referenced image exists but isn't available, instead of silent emptiness.
